Name of Equipment: Thermogravimetric Analyser (TGA) Make: NETZSCH , Model: TG 209 F1 Libra® Type: Top-loading, vacuum-tight thermogravimetric analyser Temperature Range: Room temperature to 1100°C Maximum Heating Rate: 200 K/min Measuring Range: Up to 2000 mg, including crucible Balance Resolution: 0.1 µg Sample Crucible Capacity: Up to 350 µL Operating Atmospheres: Inert, oxidising and reducing atmospheres; static and dy namic gas conditions Vacuum Capability: Up to 10⁻² mbar (1 Pa) Gas Flow Control: Three integrated mass-flow controllers Software: NETZSCH Proteus® thermal analysis software Application: Thermal stability, decomposition behaviour, mass loss, volatile content and residual mass analysis of materials.

Location of Equipment: ICFRE–Institute of Wood Science and Technology (ICFRE-IW ST), Peenya Campus, Bengaluru, Karnataka. Service Required: Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for the existing NETZSCH T G 209 F1 Libra® thermogravimetric analyser, including preventive maintenance, ins pection, calibration verification, breakdown service and restoration of instrument fun ctionality as specified in the bid. Terms and Conditions AMC of equipment should be done at buyer place, - IWST peenya campus, Bangalore. The service provider should visit 2 times per year during AMC period of 1 years(2 visits) for general service . The service provider should be authorized service provider, should enclose proprietary certific ate/OEM certificate. During AMC if any emergency on break down the service provider should immediately attend and the equi pment and put in working condition. The bidder should have a service provider / registered office in Bangalore. The Bidder should not sublet the contract. Bill should be produced twice during the AMC period for making payment. Payment will be made after receipt of invoice/Bill. Spares cost if any for spares replacement during AMC period should be intimated immediately. TGA Photos . 4.
